authors: Portugal SJ, Ozturk R, Murn CP, Potier S, Martin GR
title: Anomalous binocular vision in African Harrier-hawks
why: Measures the binocular visual field of African Harrier-hawks by the ophthalmoscopic reflex and compares it with other Accipitridae; the abstract (University of Reading record) gives no angles, so the figures for Polyboroides typus need the full text.
get: journal via library (Cell Press); the University of Reading manuscript PDF is restricted to repository staff

authors: Lisney TJ, Iwaniuk AN, Kolominsky J, Wylie DR
title: Eye Morphology and Retinal Topography in Hummingbirds (Trochilidae: Aves)
why: Already wanted by sweep 41 for Colibri; added so the ranking counts Anthracothorax. Whether the black-throated mango is among its species is unknown (the author's page names none); if it is, the paper gives its ganglion-cell peak density and a sharpness estimate. The only hummingbird work opened this session (Tyrrell et al 2018) is on Calypte and Selasphorus.
get: journal via library (Karger, Brain Behav Evol 86: 176-190)
